articles.title: Scientists Snap First Clear Photo of the Universe's Invisible Highways
articles.summary: Imagine a giant spider web made of invisible dark matter connecting galaxies. For the first time, scientists took a sharp picture of one glowing strand, a 3-million-light-year-long filament from 12 billion years ago. This cosmic highway feeds gas to baby galaxies.

articles.title: NASA Spins a Mars Helicopter Blade Faster Than the Speed of Sound!
articles.summary: NASA engineers spun a new Mars helicopter rotor so fast its tips broke the sound barrier—Mach 1.08! They did 137 tests in a special chamber that mimics the thin Martian air. This could let future Mars copters carry heavier science gear and explore places rovers can't reach.

articles.title: Fossil Teeth Reveal a Messy Family Reunion in Human Evolution
articles.summary: Imagine finding out your ancient cousins lived right next door! In Ethiopia, scientists dug up 13 fossil teeth showing that two different human-like species—Australopithecus and early Homo—shared the same neighborhood 2.6 to 2.8 million years ago. Evolution is more like a bushy tree than a straight line.
